items.briefing:
Asia Pacific leaders are calling for stronger defences against scams, a concern directly relevant to Australian organisations and their staff. Separately, a warning has been issued that AI tools — increasingly used in workplaces — can create new security risks if set up incorrectly, potentially exposing sensitive data or systems to attackers.

As AI becomes more common in daily work, it's worth being cautious about how these tools are configured and what data you share with them. **Practical tip:** If your organisation uses AI tools, check with your IT team that they are properly secured before sharing any sensitive or confidential information through them.
